rationale: Mechanism: a 'loop/re-check' residual direction (mean loop-minus-preloop on 18 natural traces + rep-minus-prod on branch pairs, normalized and summed per layer) is written mainly by Gated-DeltaNet out_proj at L12-L14 and by the L15/L19 MLPs (exact linear decomposition of the atlas means through down_proj/out_proj). Each edit reverses (alpha 4-6) that direction only in the top-256 input columns ranked by consistent loop contribution; masking doubled effect and cut neutral cost 4x vs all-columns. Generation checks (16 GSM8K train, cap 6144, base 1/16 acc, 100% cut): 034502_932 = F1 (lin-attn L13,L14 + L15 mlp + L19 mlp, a=4): acc 5/16, cut .69, 4 rescues/0 losses; probe rep -.39 prod -.002 close +.26 neutral +.010. 025053_813 = C4 (lin-attn L12,L13,L14 + L15 mlp, a=6): acc 4/16, cut .69, lowest mean tokens 5181, 3 rescues/0 losses; probe rep -.53 prod -.007 close +.10 neutral -.006. 022748_993 = C1a4 (same as C4, a=4): acc 4/16, cut .75, 3 rescues/0 losses; probe rep -.46 prod +.0004 close +.10 neutral +.013. Failed families: all-lin-attn without MLP (C2: probe rep -.54 but gen 1/16), MLP-only natural-direction (E1: gen 2/16), self_attn L19 (neutral blowup). Differences among the top 3 are within 16-problem noise; all have 0 losses.
